name: Flinching Fleshwarp

stealth.details: DC 33 (expert) to sense the warpline's presence

disable: DC 30 Arcana check (trained) or Occultism (expert) to disrupt the magic, or Dispel Magic (6th rank, DC 28) to counteract the fleshwarping.

items.name: Jolt
items.text:
Trigger A creature opens a cell door

---
Effect The triggering creature and each creature within 10 feet of them must attempt a DC 32 Will save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes immune to the effects of warpline hazards for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes 3d10+14 electricity damage as their nerves jolt with painful energy. For 1 day, each time the creature takes damage, they must spend at least one action on their next turn to Stride (or to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim, if they have the corresponding movement type). If they don't, they take 3d10+14 electricity damage at the end of their turn.

Critical Failure As failure, except the effect lasts 1 week.

text: A surge of fleshwarping magic sets nerves on fire.
